Name: Billing API
Description: Charges cards, issues invoices and sends receipts.

Name: Ledger
Description: Books every payment as a double entry.

Name: Fraud Check
Description: Scores each payment before it is accepted.

Description: The web app customers pay and manage their plans in.

Name: Data Warehouse
Description: Nightly copy of billing and customer data for reporting.

Description: Replaced by the Billing API; switched off in the spring.
